name: Nalu Vida
facts: Nalu Vida is at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier.
Heated patio steps from the sand.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–12 AM, Fri 10 AM–2 AM, Sat 9 AM–2 AM, Sun 9 AM–12 AM.
Brunch is served daily until 4 PM, with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 min).
Happy hour is Mon–Fri 3–6 PM and 10 PM–close, dine-in only.
Parking: public beach lot next to the pier, plus street parking.
Reserve a table on Resy.
20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.
Private events for parties of 10 to 100; the tour is free and so is your drink.
Joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free, one account per person.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Join bonus: +100 points once. Birthday bonus: +250 once a year.
Referral: +100 points per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Rewards: 250 pts, 500 pts, 1,000 pts ($20 off your check), 1,500 pts (free entrée up to $33).
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking. Never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens.
Ride the Nalu is a free 5-level surf game, no sign-up needed.
Game score: every 100 score = 1 rewards point, up to 50 game points a day.
The weekly game board is for bragging rights only and resets every Monday.
Nalu Vida points are separate from Melody Bar & Grill points.
Taco Tuesday: 50% off signature tacos all day.
Wednesday: $2 oysters (min 6), while supplies last.
Live scores and every game on the TVs.
Phone: (310) 437-0060. Email: info@naluvida.com. Instagram: @naluvidavenice.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11 AM–12 AM, Fri 10 AM–2 AM, Sat 9 AM–2 AM, and Sun 9 AM–12 AM. Brunch is served daily until 4 PM.

qa.q: Are you open today?
qa.a: The top of the app shows if we're open right now and when we close or open next. Our weekly hours are Mon–Thu 11 AM–12 AM, Fri 10 AM–2 AM, Sat 9 AM–2 AM, Sun 9 AM–12 AM.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Saturday and Sunday we open at 9 AM. Saturday closes at 2 AM and Sunday at 12 AM.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Mon–Thu and Sun we close at midnight. Friday and Saturday we stay open until 2 AM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier. Tap Directions in the app for a map.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: You can call us at (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What is your email?
qa.a: You can email us at info@naluvida.com.

qa.q: Where do I park?
qa.a: There's a public beach lot right next to the pier, plus street parking.

qa.q: Do you have a patio?
qa.a: Yes! We have a heated patio steps from the sand. You can also choose Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop when you order from your phone.

qa.q: Can I make a reservation?
qa.a: Yes, book your table on Resy using the Book on Resy button in the app.

qa.q: Do you take private events or large parties?
qa.a: Yes, we host private events for parties of 10 to 100 people. Come see the space: the tour is free and so is your drink. Tap Plan an event in the app.

qa.q: Is there a tip or gratuity for big groups?
qa.a: A 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.

qa.q: Do you have brunch?
qa.a: Yes, brunch is served daily until 4 PM. It comes with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 min).

qa.q: How much are the bottomless mimosas?
qa.a: Bottomless mimosas are $24 for 60 minutes, served with brunch daily until 4 PM. They're 21+ with ID.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is Monday to Friday, 3–6 PM and again from 10 PM until close. It's dine-in only.

qa.q: What is on the happy hour menu?
qa.a: $10 house margarita, wells, house red and white, and Prosecco; $2 off drafts. Food: Smash-N-Stack $15, Vegan Burger $16, Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice $16, Tostadas $14, Hula Wings (6) $14, South American Caesar $15, Buffalo Chicken Strips $10, Fries $5, Sweet Potato Fries $6.

qa.q: Is happy hour available on weekends or for takeout?
qa.a: No, happy hour is Monday to Friday only and dine-in only.

qa.q: What are today's specials?
qa.a: The Today's special card in the app shows the deal for the day. Mon: Burger Mondays. Tue: Taco Tuesday. Wed: $2 oysters. Sun: NFL Sunday. Brunch with bottomless mimosas runs daily.

qa.q: What is Burger Monday?
qa.a: Burger Mondays are $9 burgers plus a $5 draft beer special, from 5 PM to close.

qa.q: What is Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday is 50% off signature tacos all day, plus $10 house margaritas.

qa.q: Do you have oyster specials?
qa.a: Yes, Wednesdays are $2 oysters (minimum 6), while supplies last.

qa.q: What happens on Sundays?
qa.a: It's NFL Sunday: every NFL game is on the TVs, plus bottomless mimosas.

qa.q: What events do you have this week?
qa.a: The Events this week section in the app lists everything. Regular events include Monday trivia (7–9 PM), Acoustic Tuesday (8–11 PM), live jazz Thursday (6–9 PM), and Friday karaoke (9 PM to close).

qa.q: When is trivia night?
qa.a: Trivia is on Mondays from 7 to 9 PM, along with Monday Night Football.

qa.q: Do you have live music?
qa.a: Yes. Acoustic Tuesday is 8–11 PM, live jazz is Thursday 6–9 PM, and there's live blues on the 4th Saturday 3–6 PM. The 2nd Saturday is a Block Party.

qa.q: Do you have karaoke?
qa.a: Yes, karaoke is on Fridays from 9 PM to close.

qa.q: Do you have salsa nights?
qa.a: Yes, salsa is part of our event lineup. Check Events this week in the app for the date, or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Can I watch sports here?
qa.a: Yes, we show every game on the TVs, including NFL Sunday, Monday Night Football and Thursday Night Football. The app also has live scores.

qa.q: Does the app show live scores?
qa.a: Yes, tap Live scores for the Game Day at the Pier scoreboard. It covers leagues like NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS and UFC, plus LA teams.

qa.q: How do I join Nalu Vida Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free. Open the Rewards section in the app and sign up. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free.

qa.q: Do I get points for joining?
qa.a: Yes, you get +100 points once when you join.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 10 points for every $1 you spend on eligible purchases, before tip. You also get bonuses for joining, your birthday, referring friends, and playing Ride the Nalu.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). It's one receipt per day, each check once, up to $150 per check.

qa.q: Can I add a receipt from yesterday?
qa.a: Yes, you can add a visit for today or yesterday only.

qa.q: Is there a limit on points per receipt?
qa.a: Yes. You can add one receipt per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do tax and tip earn points?
qa.a: Points are 10 per $1 on eligible purchases before tip. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060 if you aren't sure what counts as eligible.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order from my table?
qa.a: Members earn 10 points per $1 on their orders. If your points don't show up, use Add my visit with your receipt.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 250 pts: free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries. 500 pts: free shareable (Chips Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs). 1,000 pts: $20 off your check. 1,500 pts: free entrée up to $33.

qa.q: How many points for a free drink?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: How many points for a free appetizer?
qa.a: 500 points gets you a free shareable: Chips Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs.

qa.q: How many points for money off my check?
qa.a: 1,000 points gets you $20 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free meal?
qa.a: 1,500 points gets you a free entrée up to $33: Steak & Fries, Tiki Ribs, Blackened Salmon, Seared Ahi, Chicken Milanese, Scampi Skewers, Adobo Chicken or Fish N' Chips.

qa.q: How do I use my reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward in the app, then show the live pass to your server, who applies it. Your points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens, so open it when you're with your server.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a visit?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, and rewards don't stack with each other.

qa.q: What does 'Come back tomorrow' mean?
qa.a: You can only get one prize per day. If you've already used a reward or won a gift today, the next one is available tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I get alcohol as a reward?
qa.a: No, rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my reward to someone else or cash it out?
qa.a: No, rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: We don't have an expiration detail in the app. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: No. Nalu Vida Rewards is one simple points balance with a rewards ladder at 250, 500, 1,000 and 1,500 points.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: Yes! You get +250 bonus points once a year on your birthday when you're a member.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: Share your code with a friend. When they join with it and make a first visit, you get +100 points for each friend.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's referral code later?
qa.a: No. You can enter one friend's code, once, when you join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Can I stack a referral with another reward?
qa.a: No, a referral never stacks with another reward on the same visit.

qa.q: Do you have an early-bird or location bonus?
qa.a: We don't have a detail on that in the app. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Do my points work at Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: No. Nalu Vida has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants. Melody has its own rewards.

qa.q: What is Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: It's our sister spot by LAX in Westchester, from the same owners. It has its own app, game and rewards.

qa.q: Do I have a digital rewards card?
qa.a: Yes, tap My Rewards Card in the Rewards section. It shows your name, card ID, points, and a QR code.

qa.q: Can I add the card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not right now. For quick access, you can add the app to your Home Screen.

qa.q: How do I put the app on my phone's home screen?
qa.a: On iPhone, open the page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, tap the menu and choose Add to Home screen or Install app.

qa.q: What is Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: It's our free surf game with 5 levels on the Venice Pier loop. You paddle out, grab food rafts, then ride the wave home and land tricks.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No sign-up needed. You can play free, with or without an account, and no purchase is necessary.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. Paddling out, tap DUCK DIVE (or the screen) as each breaking wave reaches you. Riding in, stay off the white foam, tap JUMP to launch off the lip, then do a trick and land it.

qa.q: What are the controls?
qa.a: Drag to steer. Tap JUMP or DUCK DIVE (or swipe up to launch). In the air, tap TRICK or swipe: sideways for a 360, down for a grab, up for a flip.

qa.q: What are hearts in the game?
qa.a: You start with 5 hearts, and they're lost in halves. Bumping into hazards is a mild wipeout: a splash, then you pop back up. There are no weapons or boss fights.

qa.q: What should I avoid in the game?
qa.a: Stay off the white foam when riding in, and steer around stingrays and the fisherman's stray harpoons when paddling out. Landing mid-trick is a small bail.

qa.q: How do I score points in the game?
qa.a: Grab food rafts (Island Tacos +100, Mimosa +120, Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack +150, Coconut Shrimp +150), duck-dive under waves (+100), dodge harpoons (+150), and ride the barrel out the exit (+200).

qa.q: What loses points in the game?
qa.a: Touching white foam costs 100 and half a heart. A mid-trick bail costs 150. Hitting the pier costs 200.

qa.q: How long is a level?
qa.a: Level 1 takes about 2 minutes, with a 30-second paddle-out and a 90-second ride. Later levels have a shorter paddle-out.

qa.q: How do game points turn into rewards points?
qa.a: Every 100 game score is worth 1 Nalu Vida Rewards point, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: What if I play before I join?
qa.a: Your points from today are held on your phone. Join the same day to save them.

qa.q: How many times can I play?
qa.a: You can play as often as you like for fun and score. Only 50 game points a day count toward rewards.

qa.q: Is there a weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: Yes, there's a weekly board with last week's champion and a countdown to this week's close on Sunday 11 PM. It's for bragging rights only and resets every Monday.

qa.q: Do I win a prize for a top score?
qa.a: No. The game gives no prizes, codes or discounts. The weekly board is for bragging rights only.

qa.q: When is the weekly champion picked?
qa.a: The board closes Sunday at 11 PM (LA time) and the new week starts Monday. The champion is for bragging rights, with no prize.

qa.q: What is the billboard buoy in the game?
qa.a: A billboard buoy floats by the pier about once a run. Ride through it for a +500 bonus and a link to Antidote The Foodie's review of Nalu Vida.

qa.q: Can I change the music or graphics?
qa.a: Yes. In game settings you can pick the song (Cheat Code or Xtreme Rich Person) and set graphics, weather and time of day. These only change how the game looks.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes, a Bluetooth or USB controller works in most browsers. Pair it, press any button, and use the 'Play with a game controller' help in the game.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts in the game?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: Is there a game for kids?
qa.a: Ride the Nalu has no weapons or boss fights, just a mild splash when you wipe out. We don't have a separate kid mode in the app.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: In the app, pick where you're sitting (Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop) and your table number, add items from the menu, then tap Send my order. If you scanned a table code, your seat is already picked.

qa.q: Do I need to pick a table number?
qa.a: If you sit at the Patio, Dining room or Rooftop, tap your table number (1–20) so your server finds you. At the Bar, no table number is needed.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app sends your order but doesn't take payment.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: The app menu has Shareables, Signature Island Tacos, Breakwater Bites, Entrées, Pizza & Flatbreads, Pasta, Soup & Salad, Brunch, plus Cocktails, Mocktails, Beer and Coffee. Tap Menu to browse with prices.

qa.q: What shareables do you have?
qa.a: Oysters on the Half Shell (MP), Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice $22, Coconut Shrimp $21, Bang Bang Shrimp $18, Jungle Fries $12, Chips Salsa & Guac $14, Wings $17, Tostadas de la Tierra $18, 12-Hr Smoked Pork Sliders $19, Calamari $15, Sticky Tiki Ribs $18.

qa.q: What tacos do you have?
qa.a: Tamarind Glazed Gulf Shrimp $18, Blackened Salmon $21, Vegan Chorizo $19, Baja Blaze Chicken $17, and Beer Battered Fish $20. Each order comes with two tacos.

qa.q: What burgers and sandwiches do you have?
qa.a: Smash-N-Stack Burger $18, Vegan Burger $22, BBQ Smoke Wave $22, Chipotle Chicken Sandwich $20, Cheesesteak $16, and Veggie Burrito $19. Poke Bowl is $24.

qa.q: What entrées do you have?
qa.a: Blackened Salmon $32, Shrimp Scampi Skewers $31, Chili-Kissed Sesame Seared Ahi $32, Adobo Grilled Chicken $29, Crispy Chicken Milanese $30, Steak & Fries $33, Fish N' Chips $24, and Tiki Ribs $31.

qa.q: Do you have pizza or pasta?
qa.a: Yes. Flatbreads: Margherita $15, Pepperoni $16, Elote $17, In-N-Out Style $17, BBQ Chicken $17. Pasta: Build-Your-Own Pasta $18.

qa.q: Do you have salads?
qa.a: Yes: Citrus Bomb Salad $15, South American Caesar $18, and Sesame Chicken Salad $21.

qa.q: What is on the brunch menu?
qa.a: Huevos con Gallo Pinto $19, Avocado Toast $14, French Toast $18, Breakfast Burrito $18, Steak & Eggs $29, and Breakfast Burger $15. Served daily until 4 PM.

qa.q: What cocktails do you have?
qa.a: Nalu Margarita $17, Makai $17, Frozen Cocoa De Rasta $18, Frozen Blackberry Luau $18, Pura Vida $18, Lost in Sayulita $19, Sunset Sour $20, Barrel-Aged Old Fashioned $19, and Pau Hana Punch $18. All 21+.

qa.q: Do you have non-alcoholic drinks?
qa.a: Yes: the mocktails Wish You Were Here $15 and Put the Lime in the Coconut $15, plus Coco Cold Brew coffee $11.

qa.q: What beer do you have?
qa.a: We have Nalu Vida Blonde Ale for $9.50 in the app menu, and drafts are $2 off at happy hour.

qa.q: Do you have vegan options?
qa.a: Yes. The menu includes the Vegan Burger, BBQ Smoke Wave and Vegan Chorizo Tacos. Ask your server about other options.

qa.q: What does MP mean on the menu?
qa.a: MP means market price. Ask your server for today's price.

qa.q: I have a food allergy. What should I do?
qa.a: The app doesn't list allergen details. Please tell your server before ordering, or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes, seasonal specials show up in the app around holidays, like Fourth on the Pier or Sunset for Two. Check the app for what's running now.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 language button to switch. Options include English, Español, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 437-0060. You can also email info@naluvida.com.

qa.q: I don't see my points. What should I do?
qa.a: Use Add my visit with your receipt, or ask your server. If it still looks wrong, call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What does the app record about me?
qa.a: Each time you open the app (at most once every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary, whether it opened from your Home Screen, a random phone ID, and your member ID if you joined. Approximate location is only recorded if you've already turned it on for the app.

qa.q: Do you sell my information?
qa.a: No. It's seen only by the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI, never sold and not used for ads.

qa.q: How do I stop location tracking?
qa.a: The app never asks for location just for this. Turn location off for this site or app in your phone's Settings.

qa.q: Are you on Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, follow @naluvidavenice on Instagram. Posts also show in the app.

qa.q: Can I get directions?
qa.a: Yes, tap Directions in the app to open a map to 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, at the foot of the pier.
